questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.

A) On the table stood a vase.

B) Never have I seen such a beautiful garden.

C) So fast did he run that he missed the bus.

D) It was in 1990 that she first visited Paris.
options: On the table stood a vase.
Never have I seen such a beautiful garden.
So fast did he run that he missed the bus.
It was in 1990 that she first visited Paris.
questions.answer: It was in 1990 that she first visited Paris.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the meeting time?

A) It was yesterday that we decided to postpone the meeting.

B) The meeting was yesterday that we decided to postpone.

C) Yesterday was when we decided to postpone the meeting.

D) We decided to postpone the meeting yesterday.
options: It was yesterday that we decided to postpone the meeting.
The meeting was yesterday that we decided to postpone.
Yesterday was when we decided to postpone the meeting.
We decided to postpone the meeting yesterday.
questions.answer: It was yesterday that we decided to postpone the meeting.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the third type of conditional sentence to discuss an unlikely hypothetical situation in the past.

A) If I had known about the party, I would be there now.

B) If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

C) If I were you, I would have taken that job.

D) If I had been aware of the deadline, I would have submitted the report earlier.
options: If I had known about the party, I would be there now.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I were you, I would have taken that job.
If I had been aware of the deadline, I would have submitted the report earlier.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would have taken that job.

questions.question:
Choose the sentence that appropriately uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation.

A) I suggest that he leaves immediately.

B) It is recommended that he leaves immediately.

C) We advise that he leaves immediately.

D) He should leave immediately.
options: I suggest that he leaves immediately.
It is recommended that he leaves immediately.
We advise that he leaves immediately.
He should leave immediately.
questions.answer: It is recommended that he leaves immediately.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly demonstrates ellipsis, omitting the understood words?

A) She likes coffee, and so do I.

B) She likes coffee, and she does tea.

C) She likes coffee, and I do too.

D) She likes coffee, and I like it too.
options: She likes coffee, and so do I.
She likes coffee, and she does tea.
She likes coffee, and I do too.
She likes coffee, and I like it too.
questions.answer: She likes coffee, and so do I.
